## About
We're a fully licensed auto repair shop in Pomona, proudly serving Pomona and the surrounding areas. We offer outstanding repairs done with no-hassle, quality customer service.
When something goes wrong with your vehicle, you can leave it with our ASE certified technicians. We're a STAR-certified station for smog and emissions checks, and we offer tire services at Star Tire & Auto Center too.
Customers rate us 4.4 from 166 Google reviews. A reviewer said James and crew were super friendly, and another called James personable and said Fernando is on top of his stuff.

## Services
- Smog and emissions checks: We're a STAR-certified station for smog and emissions checks.
- Tire Shop: A full range of tire services from the crew at our tire shop. Keeping you safe on the road comes first.
- Estimate Request: Get in touch with us in Pomona to request an estimate for an automotive service.
